method: Real inference allocations only; no dummy reservation. GPU sampled externally about every 0.5 s. New native process per case; Triton model arenas persist within a serving configuration.
precision: Native default CUDA permits TF32; explicitly tagged confirmation disables it using NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0. Triton profiles set use_tf32=0. All artifacts and I/O remain FP32.
limitations: Repeated scaled/pillarboxed repository sample; no labeled quality/accuracy measurement or independent RTSP/network test
Model-only request streams exclude per-frame decode, CPU Haar, temporal logic, SQL, evidence and previews
Short stress windows, no production maximum or soak certification
Host swap use rose during heavy tests, so overloaded full-pipeline FPS includes memory-pressure effects
